The scores for these relationships are consistent, indicating a plausible pathway. The mechanism involves the use of drugs that target specific genetic defects, with Rofecoxib potentially influencing the disease process through its interaction with Lacc1. The evidence supports a possible reutilization of Rofecoxib for Osteoarthritis, though the strength of the association is moderate. The findings are based on the existing drug-indication links in the primekg dataset, and further research would be needed to confirm the clinical relevance of this relationship.
